items.name: Psi-Booster (Booster)
items.notes: Book 3 PSI-DRUGS: basic psi-drug, small one-dose pills. Increases available psionic strength points by +3 if taken at full power, or +2 if at a reduced level. Additional doses within one hour have no effect; never boosts points above normal +3. Drug-induced points wane and disappear after one hour. Availability (Book 3): not in normal commercial channels; locate dealer throw 8+ after two days search (DM +1 per Streetwise level). Most dealers have only booster: 1D doses at base price Cr1,000 (prices may be higher, generally not lower). Pitfalls: three doses in three days → overdose chance 9+ within six hours of last dose; if overdose, unconscious + 3D hits; then permanent PSR −1 unless save 10+. Book 2 DRUGS table lists as Psi-Booster, Price Cr1,000, Tech Level see Psionics.

items.name: Psi-Double (Double)
items.notes: Book 3 PSI-DRUGS: more potent form; small one-dose pills. Otherwise identical to Booster, but increases psionic power by +6 if taken at full power, or +4 if at a reduced level. Availability: Double available on throw 10+; 1D−2 doses at base price Cr4,000. Same dealer-location and overdose/pitfall rules as Booster (Book 3 pp.45–46). Book 2 DRUGS table: Psi-Double, Cr4,000, Tech Level see Psionics.

items.name: Psi-Special (Special)
items.notes: Book 3 PSI-DRUGS: rarest psi-drug; liquid form, taken by injection (not pill). Gradually increases psionic strength points to 15 at one point per hour. Strength remains at this level (if unused) for four hours, then wanes one point per hour until zero; normal recovery then occurs. Danger: each use, throw 11+ → permanently reduce psionic strength rating by −1. Availability: Special on throw 12+; 1D−4 doses at base price Cr10,000. Same dealer-location and three-doses-in-three-days overdose rules as other psi-drugs. Book 2 DRUGS table: Psi-Special, Cr10,000, Tech Level see Psionics.
